_comment: A 170 degree fisheye, wide like an automotive surround-view camera: 960 x 600 gives about 106
degrees vertically. That shape matters for speed: a fisheye renders one perspective view per 120
degrees of each axis, so this is 2 views, where a square 170 degree image would be 4 (a full
scene render each). 960 x 600 keeps the full rig at about real time on an RTX 4080; 1280 x 800
costs about 10% of that. KannalaBrandt with all k = 0 is the ideal equidistant projection; set k
to a real lens's calibration to match it. DoubleSphere (xi, alpha) is the other fisheye model.
